\documentclass{scrartcl}
\DeclareNewTOC[type=remark, types=remarks, float, listname={List of Remarks}]{lrm}
\begin{document}
\listofremarks
\section{First}
Text of the first section.
\begin{remark}
A remark.
\caption{New remark}
\end{remark}
\end{document}
